about.title: One professional workflow. Multiple creative disciplines.
about.paragraph1: I work across visual production, post-production, digital marketing, web development, audio and camera technology. This multidisciplinary approach makes it possible to connect creative ideas with the technical execution needed to deliver polished, practical and platform-ready results.
about.paragraph2: Whether the requirement is a photograph, campaign video, social media strategy, website, live event sound setup, camera support or practical training, the focus stays the same: clear communication, strong presentation and reliable delivery.

expertise.title: Creative thinking. Technical execution.
expertise.text: Different projects need different combinations of skills. The advantage of a multidisciplinary service is continuity — the visual direction, technical setup, post-production, digital delivery and promotion can be planned as one connected process.
